Task 2 execution record (141.002-T).

Test-first: added tests/test_test_suite_isolation_contract.py, an AST-based
structural guard (ast.NodeVisitor walking for tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(...)
calls whose dir= keyword resolves to a .cwd() call anywhere in the expression
tree, per docs/compound/2026-08-21-ast-based-structural-regression-guards-beat-line-regex.md).
Confirmed RED first: with ALLOWLIST temporarily empty, the guard found
exactly 58 offending sites across the 4 known modules (16 test_backlog_root.py,
3 test_gate_dag_readiness_cli.py, 5 test_gate_pipeline_topology_cli.py,
34 test_gates_topology.py), matching the plan baseline exactly by file and count.

Per-site containment review (mandatory before editing, H3 refinement):
- test_gate_pipeline_topology_cli.py line 229 (test_backlog_only_workspace_succeeds):
  CONTAINMENT REQUIRED. Empirically discovered (not merely inferred): switching
  this site to plain system-temp broke the test (NO_IMPLEMENTATION_WORKTREE --
  the pipeline-topology gate's own worktree_topology check runs real `git
  worktree list` against the actual repo and requires the workspace be
  reachable inside a real implementation worktree; this is NOT mocked out by
  the test's FilesystemTopologyReaders patch, which only covers backlog-root
  resolution, not worktree topology). Anchored to
  dir=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] (N1) instead.
- test_gate_pipeline_topology_cli.py lines 247, 270 (the other two
  ...StorageRootResolutionTests methods): containment NOT required -- both
  expect an EARLIER-failing check (BACKLOG_UNAVAILABLE, from duplicate/missing
  backlog roots) before the worktree_topology check is ever reached, so
  workspace location is immaterial. Plain tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() (N1).
  Confirmed empirically: both pass with system temp.
- test_gate_pipeline_topology_cli.py lines 333, 361 (PipelineTopologyTelemetryTests):
  containment NOT required -- these call _emit_pipeline_topology_telemetry
  directly with a synthetic TopologyResult, never invoking the CLI gate or its
  worktree check at all. Plain tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() (N1). Confirmed
  empirically.
- test_gate_dag_readiness_cli.py lines 183, 196, 214 (all 3 sites,
  DagReadinessStorageRootResolutionTests): containment NOT required -- the
  dag-readiness gate has no worktree_topology check at all (a different gate
  than pipeline-topology). Plain tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() (N1). Confirmed
  empirically: all pass with system temp, both alone and combined with the
  pipeline-topology module.

IMPORTANT CORRECTION DURING THIS TASK: my first pass classified ALL 5
pipeline-topology sites as "containment not required" based on static
reading (the FilesystemTopologyReaders patch appeared to cover all CLI
behavior). Per AC-d's mandatory before/after isolation-pass-count check, I
actually ran the fixed module and found test_backlog_only_workspace_succeeds
newly failing (NO_IMPLEMENTATION_WORKTREE) -- a real regression the static
read missed. Reverted that ONE site to the anchored form and re-verified.
This is exactly why the plan requires an EMPIRICAL per-site check, not a
read-only one.

Removed both fixed modules from the guard's ALLOWLIST in the same change
(now exactly {test_gates_topology.py, test_backlog_root.py}); guard is GREEN.

AIG (victim #1, test_gate_pipeline_topology_cli.py): AIG-1 zero assertion
lines changed (git diff main -- tests/test_gate_pipeline_topology_cli.py
shows 5 hunks, each touching only the `dir=` keyword argument of a
`tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(...)` call). AIG-3/AIG-4 citation: all 5 changed
lines are class N1 (anchor argument edits: 1 to
dir=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], 4 to a bare TemporaryDirectory()).
AIG-2: the one containment-required site's temp workspace stays inside the
repository (anchored, not relocated to system temp).

Isolation pass-count parity (AC-d): both fixed modules, before (git stash to
original dir=Path.cwd() everywhere) vs after (this fix): Ran 40 tests ... OK
in both cases -- alone and combined -- identical pass counts, no assertion
weakened.

AC-a: tests/test_test_suite_isolation_contract.py exists, AST-based, names
offenders by file:line, GREEN with allowlist == {test_gates_topology.py,
test_backlog_root.py}.
AC-b: zero dir=Path.cwd() sites remain in test_gate_pipeline_topology_cli.py
or test_gate_dag_readiness_cli.py (verified via the guard's own scan).
AC-c: all 8 sites have a recorded containment determination with
justification (above).
AC-d: satisfied (isolation parity above; AIG applies and is satisfied for
victim #1).
